painpoints.text: sd was unusable at pass start: the mise shim refused every command because `/repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml` was untrusted (error: 'Config files ... are not trusted'). Running `mise trust /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml` fixed it. Run sandboxes should pre-trust the repo's mise config or expose the real `@os-eco/seeds-cli` entrypoint directly so planner passes don't burn turns on tool bootstrap (run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6).

`sd ready` and `sd list` both default to `--limit 50`, which silently truncated fabro-8822 (priority 2, sorted below ~50 High seeds) out of both listings — the goal-mandated seed looked absent from the tracker until `--limit 200` was passed. Suggest the seeds CLI warn when output is truncated by the limit, or planners should always match goal seed ids with `--limit 200`.

observations: fabro-8822 appears already fixed on HEAD (planner run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6): both parse tests pass, `ServerTargetArgs.server` carries no clap default, and the default-server fallback lives in `user_config.rs::resolve_server_target()` — brief is verification-only; only an approved review may close it.

Seed fabro-8822 names a `ServerFlag` clap type that does not exist in the tree — the real type is `ServerTargetArgs` (args.rs:151), likely naming drift from the v0.337.0-nightly.1 merge; seed descriptions referencing renamed types cost verification time until grep disambiguates.

Verification-only seed: planner brief said code was already correct on HEAD; I independently re-ran the two parse tests (2 passed) and confirmed args.rs env-only Option<String>, is_none() assertions at main.rs:710/1583, and the resolve_server_target flag→settings→default chain in user_config.rs — all held, so no changes were warranted.
